title: Replicating METR Monitoring Evaluation Methodology on a Different Monitoring System

original_idea.body:
# Replicating METR Monitoring Evaluation Methodology on a Different Monitoring System

**Problem:** METR's red-team methodology for Anthropic's monitoring has not been documented as a replicable protocol. Testing whether the same general approach yields useful results on a different system would validate the methodology.

**Direction:** Implement METR's red-teaming approach (as described in the 2026 report) against a simple open-source monitoring setup (e.g., LangSmith with custom alert rules). Document which aspects of the methodology transfer vs. require modification for different system types.

**Why it matters:** Methodology replicability is essential for building a research community around monitoring red-teaming. This study validates the METR approach as a general methodology.

**Relevant context:** METR 2026 red-teaming methodology; methodology replication; monitoring evaluation.
